title: The Atacama Cosmology Telescope: A Test of the Gravitational Force Law on Cosmological Scales Using the Kinematic Sunyaev-Zeldovich Effect
efc_relevance: kSZ pairwise-velocity test constrains g ∝ 1/r^n with n = 2.1 ± 0.3 on 30–230 Mpc (Newtonian preferred, MOND poor fit); bounds any large-scale deviation EFC's L2→L3 transition could introduce.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as blocking constraint for EFC's inter-cluster regime; require EFC L3 predictions to preserve 1/r² at 30–230 Mpc within ±0.3 in n. Cross-reference in WP3 Falsification Protocol and competitor-landscape table.
